October brings vibrant fall foliage to Newtown, Connecticut. From the iconic Main Street flagpole and historic Edmond Town Hall to the open walking paths across Fairfield Hills, the town offers a distinct mix of historic character and preserved open space. Outdoor recreation spans Lake Zoar, Treadwell Park, and miles of hiking trails at Holcombe Hill Preserve and Paugussett State Forest. Main Street and Sandy Hook village feature local dining and shops, while Interstate 84 and Route 25 provide direct connections across Greater Danbury and Fairfield County. Navigating the real estate market in New Milford, Connecticut this October involves looking closely at property taxes. Since mill rates determine your annual property tax payments based on your home's assessed value, checking the specific tax rate for the neighborhood you are considering is a crucial step. Taking this into account early helps you budget accurately and avoid surprises down the road. Whether you are looking near the town center or closer to the scenic Candlewood Lake area, understanding these numbers gives you a clearer picture of total monthly housing costs.
